kindHints.application: An application that provides or uses the data.
kindHints.system: A system of the service catalogue that holds the data.
kindHints.dataset: A dataset of Steward: its columns are compared with the contract.
kindHints.spec: An OpenAPI specification of a platform, optionally one operation.
kindHints.table: A table of a database platform or a system: its columns in the latest schema snapshot are compared with the contract.
